title: Project store
instructions: The store holds one project's files as blobs under tags, such as results/run1. Reads reach every tag of the project. store_put and store_note write only into a tag the server was started with --write-tag for, or a tag nested under one: --write-tag results allows results and results/run1. A server started with no --write-tag writes nothing.

tag.description: A tag name: letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' and '/', at most 200 bytes, no empty, '.' or '..' segment and no segment starting with '.'.

blob.description: A blob name inside the tag: printable ASCII other than '#' and '\', at most 480 bytes, no empty, '.' or '..' segment.
